proposed_fixes.title: Keep cleared Color Picker shortcut and conflict state consistent
plan: Trace the clear/save value from the shortcut control through ColorPickerViewModel.ActivationShortcut and the runner configuration.
Define whether clearing is supported; if it is, preserve the disabled/empty value and unregister the effective hotkey before refreshing conflicts.
Add a regression test covering clear, save, reopen and conflict-refresh state without treating Ignore Conflict as the fix.
verification: Assign Win+Shift+C, observe the reported conflict, clear and save it, reopen Settings and verify the effective hotkey/conflict agree.
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Clearing the shortcut may restore the default value or leave runner/conflict state stale rather than unregistering the effective hotkey; the exact branch is not yet established.

confidence.rationale: The view model maps null to DefaultActivationShortcut, but the control may send a different empty representation and runtime conflict refresh has not been traced.

fix_assessment.rationale: Run the clear/save/reopen reproduction and trace the effective shortcut, then refine the proposed fix.

judgment.recommended_action: Run the clear/save/reopen reproduction and trace the effective shortcut, then refine the proposed fix.
evidence: The reporter cleared Win+Shift+C, saved an apparently empty assignment, and still sees a conflict. Ignore Conflict hides the notice but does not establish registration state.
No diagnostic archive or screenshot was supplied; the sequence itself is sufficiently concrete for local reproduction.
Read the complete report. ColorPickerViewModel.ActivationShortcut substitutes DefaultActivationShortcut when assigned null.
GlobalHotkeyConflictManager caches runner-provided conflict groups and matches modifier/key values; ColorPicker set_config parses the hotkey then saves settings.
The input-control representation of a cleared shortcut and runner refresh sequence remain unverified; a stale-cache-only cause is not established.
judgment.rationale: Reproduce locally and inspect the effective hotkey/configuration before asking the reporter for general logs. A narrow consistency fix is plausible but must not silently change the intended clear/reset semantics.

reproduce.expected_result: The displayed shortcut, actual registration and conflict notification agree; a disabled shortcut must not retain an active conflict.
steps: 1. Open Color Picker shortcut assignment and clear it.
2. Save and inspect the conflict panel.
3. Close and reopen Settings, then test whether the old shortcut still activates Color Picker.
reproduce.title: Reproduce clearing Color Picker shortcut
setup: Record the effective shortcut before starting; do not use Ignore Conflict during the test.
